# Factory programs

These are the six unmodified JSON programs from rcell233/OpenIFW at commit
`a478abd0645225add3f2a7751522da1bced7a2e6`. Names, authors, parameter values,
settings, effect parameters and original ProgramIndex values are preserved.

IFW and the factory preset names and parameter sets are credited to STUDIO-R.
These materials are not relicensed under OpenIFW's MIT license or this port's
GPL license; their respective rights remain with their authors.

OpenIFW's synthesis implementation is independent work. No original IFW
application code or native binary is included.
